_what: foreign net buying by phase of the rebalance window, as a multiple of the same stock's own normal day

method.baseline: median |daily foreign net| / ADV over the 100 sessions ending 31 before the announcement, per stock, requiring >= 60 covered sessions
method.phases_per_session: pre = mean over covered T86 sessions of the 30 before ann (c-368), ann-to-eff /sessions, effective day /1, post /10
method.netting_caveat: T86 nets ALL foreign accounts to one number, so tracker buying netted against foreign selling UNDERSTATES gross index demand
